A=df['A'].values;t=df['t'].values;y=df['dA_dt'].values

T={}

for b in np.linspace(0.05,4,120): T[('sin',b)]=np.sin(b*t); T[('cos',b)]=np.cos(b*t)
P=np.arange(-2,4.01,0.25)
cand=[(k,p) for k in T for p in P]
Mv=np.array([T[k]*A**p for k,p in cand])  # ~ (39k? ) check size
print(Mv.shape)
base=A**3
# stage1: best first term
sc=[]
for i in range(Mv.shape[0]):
    X=np.column_stack([base,Mv[i]])
    c,res_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
    sc.append(np.sum((y-X@c)**2))
sc=np.array(sc); order=np.argsort(sc)[:4]

results=[]

    for j in range(Mv.shape[0]):
